title: Panel feature gating — midweek scrum notes
content:
Meeting: Midweek sync — Panel feature gating / UI rollouts / analytics sweep
Date: 2026-08-17
Owner: Marisol Vega (notes)
Attendees: Marisol, Daniel, Ruth, Ethan, Priya (+ async from SRE)

Quick context (one-liner):
We’re ramping the new Panel multi-pane UX under a feature flag. This doc captures the standup items, gating thresholds, metrics to watch during the canary, and immediate action items for tomorrow’s ramp. Working doc — expect edits.

HIGHLIGHTS / DECISIONS
- Canary window: 09:00–14:00 PDT on Friday (targeted traffic slice = 1% -> 5% if stable). See Confluence: ci-panel-gating-plan-924.
- Primary gating metric: 99th percentile interaction latency for panel render (client-observed time) must stay <= 180ms above baseline. Secondary: error rate (5xx/wrong fragment) < 0.15%.
- Fallback plan decided: automatic flag rollback if either condition breached for 3 consecutive 5-min buckets OR if Datadog anomaly score on panel-render spikes > 0.8.

STANDUP NOTES (by subteam)
1) UI / Frontend (Daniel + Priya)
- Daniel: fixed debounce edge causing duplicated onClick telemetry when switching panes. Patch landed in PR #2142 — awaiting review from Priya. Manual QA notes: intermittent failure only on Safari iOS — suspicious timing with the input focus handler.
- Priya: A/B variant hook implemented to test optimistic render vs progressive hydration. Opt-in flag = panel_opt_hydration_v2. Need to confirm cookie/persistent flag handling across SSO redirect (INF-1789 ticket).
- TODO: add small client-side histogram to capture first-pane-paint (FPPanel) and send as low-sampling metric during canary. Daniel to push lightweight probe by Thu EOD.
- Note to self: check bundling diff — new bundle +1.1KB (should be fine), but double-check source maps for new code path.

2) Rollouts / Flags (Ruth)
- Flag config prepared: ramp schedule 1% -> 2% at +30m -> 5% at +2h. Canary gate rules encoded in LaunchDarkly targeted rule set.
- Need a quick backstop: add a manual kill switch pinned to infra alert channel (#panel-canary-alerts) with runbook steps. Draft of runbook is at Confluence link in linked_artifacts.
- Ruth: verifying that Dedicated and Private deployments will be excluded from the first canary (we only target hosted API customers). Confirmed.

3) Analytics / Observability (Ethan + SRE async)
- Ethan: dashboards created — Panel Canary Overview (hosted-only): KPIs shown:  p99 render latency, mean CPU per shard, errors by fragment, trace sampling rate. Dashboards saved in Datadog: dd-dashboard-id: 9821.
- Issue: sampling of KV-cache traces for panel flows currently at 1/1000; for the canary we need 1/50 to investigate cold-cache edge cases. Ethan to coordinate with SRE to bump sampling Thursday night and revert after canary.
- SLO watch: set up quick synthetic that fires 1m frequency for the panel landing flow. If synthetic latency > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive points, post to #panel-canary-alerts and trigger runbook.

BLOCKERS / RISKS
- Safari iOS duplication bug (frontend) — if it’s widespread it could cause telemetry noise that masks backend regressions. Priority for triage.
- Trace rate increase — bumping sampling to 1/50 could add noise/ingest to observability budget. Finance/code owners ok for short window but confirm retention/ingest thresholds.
- Dedicated customers exclusion tested but edge-case: dedicated tenants that use hosted auth redirect flow might still receive flag. Ruth to validate the targeting logic with identity team.

DEEP DIVE: Canary gating thresholds (Ruth + Ethan proposal)
- Primary: client p99 render latency delta vs baseline <= +180ms for 30m moving window. Baseline = last 14 days median-day at equivalent traffic.
- Secondary: error rate (fragment parse errors + 5xx) must stay < 0.15% over 30m window.
- Safety net: increase in CPU utilization per rendering shard > +25% sustained over 15m -> automatic rollback.
- Manual rollback criteria: any P0 reported by oncall or >2 customer reports in 20m, irrespective of metrics.

ACTION ITEMS (owner — due)
- Daniel: push client histogram probe for FPPanel and wire to low-sample metric (due 2026-08-20).
- Priya: finish Safari iOS repro + quick fix branch (if reproduced) (due 2026-08-18 EOD).
- Ruth: publish runbook in Confluence and add kill switch to LaunchDarkly rule set (due 2026-08-19).
- Ethan: bump trace sampling to 1/50 for canary window and create a revert job (due before canary start).
- Marisol: confirm targeted traffic slice in the experimentation service and notify growth / product about canary (due 2026-08-18).

FOLLOW-UPS / OPEN QUESTIONS
- Do we want to include a short user-facing banner for canary participants explaining they might see experimental layout? Product leaning no for hosted-only small slices, but Growth suggested adding a telemetry opt-out. Decision pending.
- Are there any billing implications if we increase trace sampling during the canary? Finance to confirm, but SRE said short window should be fine — Ethan to chase.
- How do we measure perceived latency vs backend render time? Suggested metric = client_observed_render - server_fragment_ready. Need to ensure clocks are aligned or use trace correlation id. Priya to add trace id propagation in the hydration path.

NOTES TO SELF / LOOSE IDEAS
- If Safari repro is flaky, record with iOS WebKit telemetry flag + repro script in BrowserStack; leave notes in the PR so reviewers can reproduce locally.
- Consider adding a small rollout that toggles progressive hydration order (left-to-right first) for accessibility testing. Could be separate micro-experiment later.
- Low-priority: explore localStorage vs cookie for the feature flag persistence to better survive SSO redirects.

ASYNC UPDATES (captured during day)
- 12:14 — Daniel: PR #2142 updated, addressed Priya comments, removed an extra setTimeout.
- 15:40 — Ruth: LaunchDarkly rule now includes hosted-only constraint, but noted an edge-case for ephemeral tokens (investigating).
- 17:02 — Ethan: Datadog panel added, test synthetic firing and passing locally.

SUMMARY / NEXT MEETING
- Next sync: Thursday 2026-08-18 10:00 PDT — quick pre-canary check. Main canary window on Friday.
- High priority for tomorrow: Safari repro, histogram probe, trace sampling bump, runbook publish.

End of notes.

(Internal draft — do not share externally; copy important runbook steps to the official Confluence runbook when finalized.)
